name: index-engine-capacitor
description: Capacitor native shell for the EFNAI Index Engine V9.1.0.1 SPA

scripts.android:add: npm run web:sync && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:sync && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.ios:add: npm run web:sync && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run web:sync && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive:unsigned: npm run ios:sync && mkdir -p ios/App/build && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -archivePath ios/App/build/Index-Engine.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive
